rubric.name: include-root-routes milestone close
criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, the milestone does not demonstrably do what its goal predicates claim, or a result in the results file is not supported by the cited records or code. "No concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.

Does every goal predicate in the plan have evidence in the results that would fail if the predicate were false? Read the phase records 002-phase-IR1.md, 003-phase-IR2.md, 004-phase-IR3.md and the tests they cite before judging.

Do the shipped code paths (src/gnd/api.py judgments, src/gnd/judgments.py, src/gnd/extract/flatten_service.py, src/gnd/export/include_roots.py, src/gnd/export/emit.py, src/gnd/export/pyrel_rules.py) behave as the results and delta say, in particular for models without includes, which must be unchanged?
Is every open question raised in the milestone's records dispositioned in the results (closed, carried with an owner, or an accepted residual), and is any disposition wrong?
Are the close amendments in plan section 11 each supported by the record that raised them, with the prior wording kept?
Every concern's evidence must cite one of the three named files; name the record, code or test line in the observation.
